title: Writing: My Favourite Sport
writingModel: My name is Amir and my favourite sport is football. I have played football since I was six years old.
I love football because it is a team sport. You cannot win alone — you need to work together, communicate, and support each other. I have learned many important life lessons from playing football.
I have been part of the WKU football team for two years. We have played eight matches this season, and we have won five of them. I haven't scored in a final yet, but I am still trying.

I train three times a week — on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. I have also watched many professional matches. My favourite player is Gennady Golovkin — not a footballer, I know, but he inspires me with his dedication.
If you haven't tried a team sport yet, I highly recommend it. Sport teaches you discipline, resilience, and how to handle both victory and defeat.
